limits: Functional full4 in one Chrome OS process with three fresh case contexts plus separate-store WAV context, not three process restarts.
All old failures and preimages retained; no source/oracle edits or retries.
Three fresh main case browser contexts share one OS Chrome process; the WAV relink uses a separate store/context.
Raw artifact-domain SHA fields are declared/test-asserted values; review independently hashes the complete saved raw files and checks saved/restored equality.
Native Web Audio graph/control and logicalIntent/NATIVE_CURSOR_PARTIAL evidence do not establish PCM, exact native cursor phase, human hearing or deadline compliance.
Original served-index SHA readiness is supported by the successful unchanged runner and retained traces. Individual current response-body coverage for all12 assets was not inspected or newly probed.
Before/after immutable source snapshots define the run cutoff; later Root doc writes are outside this audit.
No current600s, timestep/performance, cross-engine, hearing, Meta LIVE, billing or wholeV1 success inferred.
